newsitem.title: USA: AVIC Group wins cable TV upgrade in China.
newsitem.headline: AVIC Group wins cable TV upgrade in China.

text.p: AVIC Group International Inc said Thursday its majority owned Chinese subsidiary, Hebei United Telecommunications Equipment Co, signed a contract with the Hebei Provincial Cable Television Station for a $45 million upgrade of Hebei's existing cable network.

The company said Hebei's network currently serves 1.6 million people in the People's Republic of China and is the only provider of cable television in the province of 64 million people which surrounds Beijing.

AVIC, which develops telecommunications projects in China, said the two-year upgrade will double the number of subscribers in the province to three million by the year 2000 and to reach five million by the year 2005.
The number of homes passed by the network will increase from 2.5 million currently to 12.5 million by 2000, the company said.
